observations: Multiple wooden pallets stacked outdoors on dry grass.
Pallets show signs of age and use, with visible wear and some darkened areas.
A blue and a purple sticker with the letter 'H' are visible on the side of the pallets.
The top pallet in the stack is shown with its top surface tilted to reveal the underside.
Watermarks for 'EMMY BEST INTEGRATED' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on all images.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added. Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Structural integrity and stability of the pallets
risks.proof: A video showing a person standing on the top pallet or a close-up of the bottom edge.

risks.risk: Actual weight and condition of the pallets
risks.proof: A photo of the pallets with a scale or a handwritten note showing the weight.
risks.if_unproven: as a low-value, used, and possibly damaged lot

risks.risk: The presence of hidden defects like rot or insect damage
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the bottom and side of the pallets.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the pallets with a scale showing their actual weight.
Video of someone standing on the top pallet to test its stability.
Photo of the bottom and sides of the pallets to check for rot or damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as wooden pallets. While the condition and weight are unverified, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a used, damaged, and unstable lot.
